items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Er muss zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung beim Landkreis Musteruckermark – Bußgeldstelle vorliegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The letter was formally served (Zustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO) and the attached scan of the envelope states the delivery date in the courier's own hand: 'zugestellt am 24.11.2026'. Because this is a formal service (yellow-envelope style, Postzustellungsurkunde), there is no statutory deemed-delivery fiction here; the actual service date on the Urkunde (24.11.2026, a Tuesday) is the anchor. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of service itself is not counted; the two-week period begins 25.11.2026. Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period of weeks ends with the day of the last week that bears the same name as the day the triggering event fell on, i.e. 14 days after 24.11.2026 = Tuesday, 08.12.2026. That day is a normal business day in Brandenburg (no weekend/holiday shift needed), so it stands. The Einspruch must be in writing or declared for the record and must actually reach the Bußgeldstelle by that date (not merely be postmarked), so it should be sent well before.

items.title: Pay the total fine (Geldbuße, Gebühr and Auslagen) once the Bescheid becomes final
items.quote: Fällig wird der Betrag zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist.
items.computation: Payment is not due on a fixed calendar date but two weeks after the Bußgeldbescheid becomes 'rechtskräftig' (final). Assuming no Einspruch is filed, the decision becomes final at the end of the two-week objection period computed above, i.e. at the end of Tuesday 08.12.2026 (the day the Einspruch deadline expires unused). Treating 08.12.2026 as the triggering event day, § 187 Abs. 1 BGB excludes that day from the count, so counting starts 09.12.2026; § 188 Abs. 2 BGB then gives the end of the two-week period as 14 days after 08.12.2026 = Tuesday, 22.12.2026, a normal business day with no shift needed. This date is contingent: if an Einspruch is filed in time, rechtskräftig (and hence the due date) is postponed or never occurs for this amount, so this date only applies if no objection is raised.

warnings: This is clearly a specimen/template letter (sender address 'Landkreis Musteruckermark', town 'Musterprenzlau', bank name 'Landesmusterbank', and an example.com-style email address); if a real letter of this kind is received, the Landkreis name, bank (IBAN DE92 1705 6060 0001 7291 00) and contact details should be checked against the authority's genuine, independently looked-up contact information before any payment is made.

The 232.00 EUR payment due date depends on the fine becoming final (rechtskräftig), which in turn depends on no Einspruch being filed by 08.12.2026 — if an Einspruch is filed, this payment deadline does not apply as stated.

The IBAN given (DE92 1705 6060 0001 7291 00) is a technically valid German IBAN, but a valid IBAN does not prove who owns the account; confirm it matches the Landkreis's officially published bank details before paying.
